QUAKER.gloss: one who quakes and trembles with fear
QUAKER.definition: One who quakes and trembles with (or as with) fear.

QUAKE.gloss: shaking and vibration at the surface of the earth resulting from underground movement…
QUAKE.definition: Shaking and vibration at the surface of the earth resulting from underground movement along a fault plane or from volcanic activity.

QUARK.gloss: hypothetical truly fundamental particle in mesons and baryons
QUARK.definition: (physics) hypothetical truly fundamental particle in mesons and baryons; there are supposed to be six flavors of quarks (and their antiquarks), which come in pairs; each has an electric charge of +2/3 or -1/3.
QUARK.example: Quarks have not been observed directly but theoretical predictions based on their existence have been confirmed experimentally.

RAKE.gloss: move through with or as if with a rake
RAKE.definition: Move through with or as if with a rake.
RAKE.example: She raked her fingers through her hair.

ARE.gloss: a unit of surface area equal to 100 square meters
ARE.definition: A unit of surface area equal to 100 square meters.

ERA.gloss: a period marked by distinctive character or reckoned from a fixed point or event
ERA.definition: A period marked by distinctive character or reckoned from a fixed point or event.

EAR.gloss: the sense organ for hearing and equilibrium
EAR.definition: The sense organ for hearing and equilibrium.

ARK.gloss: a boat built by Noah to save his family and animals from the flood
ARK.definition: A boat built by Noah to save his family and animals from the flood.
